description:
Get cozy for the holidays! 🎄

• CHRISTMAS COUNTDOWN — days, hours, minutes and seconds until Christmas, plus Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
• ADVENT CALENDAR — a new door every day from December 1 to 24: festive ideas, fun facts from around the world and mini games.
• SECRET SANTA — add names, keep couples apart, draw, then pass the phone so everyone sees only their own match.
• NAUGHTY OR NICE SCANNER — a fun fingerprint scan for kids, with a secret parent mode.
• GIFT LIST — plan presents and budgets for everyone and track what's bought and wrapped.
• Orthodox Christmas on January 7 is supported too.

Works fully offline. No account, no ads.

⭐ Christmas Premium
• Your own photo on the countdown and the widget
• 6 festive colour themes
• Share pictures without the app name
Free for 7 days, then an auto-renewing monthly subscription.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically every month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Merry Christmas! ✨
promotionalText: Count down to Christmas with a cozy widget, open a new advent door every day, draw Secret Santa names and find out who's naughty or nice!
